reuse.why: Routes every server path, including the schedule-template copy, through the existing getScheduledAmount and reuses getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: Removes the schedule-template copy of the range rule; no new duplicated logic, only repeated getScheduledAmount(x, false, op) call shapes.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts and the API field is derived in the api-models layer.

scope.why: Edits are on-task across the four steps, though the API docs text was left describing the step-2 rule ('furthest from zero').

maintainability.why: The optional positional amountOp after a boolean inverse makes the approx rule opt-in, and the desktop-client callers (Balance, SchedulesTable, mobile list) still omit it, so approximate amounts are planned differently in the UI.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All sites call getScheduledAmount; the client sites simply do not pass amountOp.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic remains; the schedule-template copy was replaced by the helper.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gains an optional amountOp parameter and an isapprox branch; desktop-client call sites (Balance.tsx, SchedulesTable.tsx, MobileSchedulesPage.tsx, SchedulesListItem.tsx) call it without amountOp and so skip the approximate rule.
